questions.question: Describe null hypothesis, alternate hypothesis, significance level and p-value in respect of paired-sample t-test. / [CO3] [15x1 = 15]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe null hypothesis, alternate hypothesis, significance level and p-value in
  • respect of paired-sample t-test. [U] / [CO3]
  • (Null Hypothesis – 4 Marks; Alternate Hypothesis – 3 Marks; Significance
  • Level – 4 Marks; p-value – 4 Marks)
  • Null Hypothesis (H₀) – No difference
  • Alternate Hypothesis (H₁) – Difference
  • Significance Level (α) – 0.05 level
  • p-value – Probability value
  • Decision –
  • p ≤ 0.05 Reject H₀
  • p > 0.05 Accept H₀
  • [15x1 = 15]
